description: This Java source file defines the class ExistingOrNewVisitAssignmentHandler, which manages the assignment of encounters to existing visits or creating new visits within the OpenMRS medical record system. It contains logic to map encounter types to visit types, initialize visit objects, and handle global property changes related to visit assignment configurations.

classes.name: ExistingOrNewVisitAssignmentHandler
classes.description: This class is a handler that assigns encounters to existing visits or creates new ones, based on the encounter type and configured global properties. It implements logic to support global property listening and manages an internal mapping between encounter types and visit types.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a localized display name for the handler, used in UI representations.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter
methods.description: Prepares an encounter for saving by assigning it to an appropriate visit, either existing or new, based on encounter type and global configuration.

methods.name: loadVisitType
methods.description: Reads the global property configuration to determine and load the appropriate visit type for a given encounter type.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Checks if the handler supports a given global property name.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Resets internal mappings when relevant global properties are altered.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Resets internal mappings when relevant global properties are deleted.

methods.name: setEncounterVisitMapping
methods.description: Sets the internal static mapping between encounter types and visit types.
